outcome: pregnancy-related outcomes (hypertension, gestational diabetes mellitus, miscarriage, live births)
infant hematological and other adverse outcomes
cohort: The study analyzed 14 pregnancies in 12 women exposed to clozapine.
finding: Clozapine use in pregnancy was not associated with congenital malformations but was associated with miscarriage in one-third of pregnancies.
mod_finding: Among the 9 live births, 6 were normal vaginal deliveries and 3 were cesarean sections.
